name: zgeometry_weiler_generate_outside_results
description: zGeometry_Weiler::GenerateOutsideResults emits an outside-result polygon span and wrapped B/A point bridge when clip mode requests outside output.
known_limits: Binary Ninja HLIL renders the output point cursor and wraparound contour walks as mixed raw pointer arithmetic; assembly comments map those operations to 12-byte zVec3 steps.
tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zGeometry Weiler source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4687b0 validates the clipMode bit-2 early success path, polygonSetBBuffer and pointListBuffer appends, polygon span pointDwordOffset and pointCount writes, outClip counter updates, max-X/max-Y point selection loops, SelectForwardStartPointInContourA call, forward wrapped contour-B copy, reverse wrapped contour-A copy, and failure returns for append failures.

The native clip leaf smoke verifies the outside-disabled return path and an outside-enabled case with polygon span allocation, point-list allocation, outClip pointer updates, counter updates, pointDwordOffset, pointCount, and wrapped B/A output point order.
